deckTitle: Propositum 2040: Forget Utopia, Ignore Dystopia, Embrace Protopia

cards.power: Skip a turn while staring at the clouds; discard one resource to the Dystopia pile.
cards.lore: A fictional default built on somebody else's dystopia.
cards.gradeReason: Poodle-on-clouds is clear but 'Dystopia pile' needs table context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Poodle floating on clouds above scurrying rats. Dreamy absurdist.

cards.power: Board freezes for one round. Player collects 3 profit tokens from the burning bank.
cards.lore: A cautionary tale that devolved into desperate escapism and a disaster capitalism product roadmap.
cards.gradeReason: Sloth with VR headset eating popcorn in burning forest. Play it NOW.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Sloth in VR goggles eating popcorn, forest ablaze behind. Darkly comic.

cards.power: Steal 1 resource from all other players to mitigate damage.
cards.lore: Takes and takes. Believes sustainability is just mitigating the damage we keep doing.
cards.gradeReason: Giant tick in suit sucking the globe is vivid; mechanic needs framing.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Bloated tick in business suit gripping a dripping Earth. Grotesque corporate.

cards.power: Repair one broken board tile. Draw a card.
cards.lore: Proactive prototyping. A realistic vision of tackling inequities for a world built on reciprocity.
cards.gradeReason: Badger with tools is clear; lore is theoretical framework, not an invitation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Badger with tool belt patching cracked wall, water spraying. Industrious warmth.

cards.power: Instantly silence all critical inquiry cards in play.
cards.lore: Evangelizing singular tech as a magic pill without a shred of critical inquiry.
cards.gradeReason: Snake in black turtleneck holding glowing pill. Silicon Valley archetype. Instant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Snake in black turtleneck holding glowing capsule with halo. Slick tech-cult.

cards.power: Force an opponent from the Global South to pay 70k tokens just to play a card.
cards.lore: Excludes the majority of the world. You aren't a real futurist unless you buy their models.
cards.gradeReason: Owl on pile of money guarding vault of diplomas. Instantly recognizable. Play it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Owl perched on cash mountain guarding diploma-covered vault door. Academic greed.

cards.power: Destroy 3 worker-ants on your board for +1 Tech Ego point.
cards.lore: Profiteering from a tech-optimism that has brought us to the absolute brink.
cards.gradeReason: Hamster on rocket is funny; 'Tech Ego point' mechanic opaque without context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Goggled hamster riding rocket with ants burning off hull. Manic tech bro.

cards.power: Megaphone blast. All players lose their next action phase due to total paralysis.
cards.lore: Sells a binary vision of civilizational collapse that paralyzes society into total inaction.
cards.gradeReason: Crow with megaphone making mice freeze in terror. Pure performative doom. Instant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Black crow screaming through megaphone, mice paralyzed below. Apocalyptic noise.

cards.power: Gain +5 Profit every time another player loses a resource to a fire or flood event.
cards.lore: Oh, the world is burning? I can make a lot of profit off harming people and the planet.
cards.gradeReason: Vulture in hard hat perched on drowning house. Perfect, iconic, no explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Vulture in yellow hard hat perched on flood-submerged house. Predatory glee.

cards.power: Convert an opponent's free action into a paid micro-transaction.
cards.lore: Believes humans won't act without financial incentive. Distorts outcomes and harms processes.
cards.gradeReason: Hyena with crypto chains selling canned AIR is funny; needs game frame to land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Sunglasses hyena with blockchain jewelry selling canned air to fish. Crypto hustle.

cards.power: Generate 10 Toxic Waste tokens, then donate 1 token to charity to clear your reputation score.
cards.lore: Make millions in fossil fuels, donate to effective charities, and call it corporate social responsibility.
cards.gradeReason: Golden pig on oil rig dropping coin to mouse while smokestacks belch. Instant satire masterclass.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Rotund gilded pig on oil rig dropping single coin to tiny mouse. Corporate absolution.

cards.power: Privatize the commons. Players must pay you 1 token each turn just to draw a card.
cards.lore: The ultimate commoditization of the commons. Only the wealthy can afford to breathe.
cards.gradeReason: Chipmunk with gas mask in wasteland is evocative; 'privatize the commons' needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Chipmunk in gas mask and survival pack by dead tree in smog wasteland. Bleak commodity.

cards.power: Ignore all present board damage. Claim victory points for imaginary games played a billion years from now.
cards.lore: Disregards present climate impacts for trillions of imaginary lives billions of years away.
cards.gradeReason: Worm with telescope gazing at galaxy while rat suffers below. Clever, needs philosophical brief.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Worm using telescope to gaze at galaxy while rat decays beside equations. Cosmic detachment.

cards.power: Sacrifice an opponent's low-tier card to Fund your high-tier AI Armageddon research.
cards.lore: Twisted logic arguing that AI armageddon research is a better charity than feeding a starving child.
cards.gradeReason: Cyborg fox at chalkboard with equations is strong; EA movement knowledge needed for full G1.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Cyborg fox at equation-covered chalkboard ignoring pleading frog. Cold utilitarian logic.

cards.power: Deflect all blame. Immune to accountability cards because the technology wanted it.
cards.lore: Preaches "What Technology Wants" as inevitable, hiding the fact that specific humans designed it to abuse you.
cards.gradeReason: Beaver kneeling before glowing chip is vivid; 'accountability card' mechanic needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Beaver kneeling before glowing microchip on stone altar, tools scattered. Technological fatalism.

cards.power: Change the definition of any keyword on the board until it means nothing.
cards.lore: Steals good words like "long-term" and strips them of meaning until nothing is real.
cards.gradeReason: Colorful parrot shredding newspaper letters into smoke. Instantly performable chaos agent.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Chaotic parrot ripping newspaper letters into burning smoke and nothing. Language vandal.

cards.power: Requires ten Earth board-spaces to play. Consumes 100x the resources of any other card.
cards.lore: Consumes hundreds of times more than the poorest. A planetary model that requires ten Earths.
cards.gradeReason: Peacock on mountain of gold while ants carry Earths below. No explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Preening peacock atop gold mountain, tiny ants carrying miniature Earths beneath. Imperial excess.

cards.power: Take 3 damage for climate impacts you didn't cause, but gain the unblockable Pioneer Solution ability.
cards.lore: Where the future actually happens. Contributed the least to climate impacts, set to suffer the worst.
cards.gradeReason: Donkey with oxygen tanks in arid landscape is powerful; asymmetry mechanic needs explaining.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Weathered donkey with oxygen tank backpack in cracked desert landscape. Dignified resilience.

cards.power: Steal the aesthetic of a marginalized card to bypass corporate defense walls.
cards.lore: Hiring marginalized faces to sell exploitative crypto to vulnerable communities.
cards.gradeReason: Chameleon with 'Casting: Diversify!' flier is clever; corporate diversity-washing needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Colorful chameleon holding corporate diversity casting flier with curled tongue. Predatory inclusion.

cards.power: Cast a vote from the discard pile that locks the current board state for the unborn.
cards.lore: Dead people screwing up the future for the unborn by funding conservative agendas from the grave.
cards.gradeReason: Skeleton in grave clutching legal will. Darkly funny, instantly legible political archetype.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Grinning skeleton in burial pit clutching 'Legal Will' document. Posthumous power.

cards.power: Scramble the text of any rule card. Nothing is real, then everything is possible.
cards.lore: Nothing is real, then everything is possible. Confuse the public to achieve geopolitical goals.
cards.gradeReason: Toad typing at keyboard with symbols exploding. Internet troll archetype. Instant recognition.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Glowing-eyed toad at keyboard, reality symbols fragmenting outward. Geopolitical chaos agent.

cards.power: Create a narrative vacuum. Gain +1 Follower for every broken system on the board.
cards.lore: A brand new religion filling the narrative vacuum left by broken systems.
cards.gradeReason: Hamster in tinfoil crown at conspiracy corkboard. Global icon. Zero context needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Manic hamster in tinfoil crown pointing at red-string conspiracy board. Fringe religion.

cards.power: Randomly distribute 3 Fake News damage tokens to younger player cards.
cards.lore: Unconditioned for tech literacy, becoming the largest vector for the most outrageous conspiracies.
cards.gradeReason: Turtle with tablet surrounded by winged demons is vivid; 'Fake News damage tokens' is mechanic-dense.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Angry elderly turtle transfixed by glowing tablet, cartoon demons floating above. Tech fear.

cards.power: Trigger fear response. Extract maximum profit tokens with zero imagination points spent.
cards.lore: It's janky, it's cheap, but triggering the fear response makes the most money with the least imagination.
cards.gradeReason: Bat projecting zombie VR heads is clever; 'imagination points' currency needs table context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Upside-down bat projecting zombie VR faces at tiny cowering animals. Fear commerce.

cards.power: Center the bleeding edge. Automatically prevents the next global harm event card from activating.
cards.lore: Centering those at the absolute edge of technological and social harm prevents the greatest global impacts.
cards.gradeReason: Armored roaring bear is powerful visually; 'bleeding edge' as disability justice frame needs brief.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Roaring bear in mechanical armor, mid-charge, golden energy burst. Disability justice warrior.

cards.power: Plurality is survival. Convert an opponent's Either/Or attack into a Plurality resource.
cards.lore: Plurality is survival. We need actual curiosity for divergent perspectives, not just tolerance.
cards.gradeReason: Flamingo smashing binary code wall with walking stick. Immediate and politically sharp.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Vibrant flamingo cracking binary code wall with cane, bees nearby. Queer futurity.

cards.power: Reveal the true history of a stolen board resource and reclaim it for the ecosystem.
cards.lore: Knew humans were a narrative species centuries before pop intellectuals sold millions of books saying it.
cards.gradeReason: Elephant with glowing root system is beautiful; 'stolen board resource' mechanic is abstract.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Elephant tending glowing soil mandala with root network underground. Ancestral knowing.

cards.power: Lived experience. Play 3 action cards simultaneously when the water starts rising.
cards.lore: Lived experience on the ground beats an Ivory Tower PhD when the water starts rising.
cards.gradeReason: Octopus juggling climate crises with eight arms. Multi-axis action is literally embodied. Instant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Octopus wielding fire, flood, sun and gears simultaneously in crisis. Lived intersectionality.

cards.power: Stamp out diversity. Replace an opponent's unique card with a blank white square.
cards.lore: Takes a highly privileged, Western, white, male perspective and pretends it is neutral.
cards.gradeReason: Sheep through industrial press producing blank white copies. Perfect mechanical metaphor. Instant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Sheep with backpack fed into industrial press, blank white sheets emerge. Diversity erasure.

cards.power: Decolonize a project for 0 tokens. The Corporate Expediter takes all the credit.
cards.lore: Invited to decolonize the project with unpaid labor, entirely uncredited in the final product.
cards.gradeReason: Ant carrying oversized 'Humanity Centered Design' book is sharp; credit-theft mechanic needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Tiny ant hauling giant 'Humanity Centered Design' book uphill alone. Unpaid labor.

cards.power: Ignore all pandemic damage but permanently lose all credibility points.
cards.lore: Predicted pandemics were a thing of the past right before COVID hit. Still refuses to answer for it.
cards.gradeReason: Ostrich head in 2019 bestseller while COVID particles float. Zero explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Ostrich burying head in '2019 Bestseller' book, virus particles floating above. Willful blindness.

cards.power: Apply a green veneer. Sell 3 toxic assets as sustainable for double profit.
cards.lore: Consulting for industry just to help them sell more stuff with a thin veneer of sustainability.
cards.gradeReason: Weasel in suit painting smokestack green is legible; 'green veneer' mechanic needs framing.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Dapper weasel in suit painting toxic factory stack bright green. Greenwash consultant.

cards.power: A better future is in the making. The moment you repair a card, draw a new challenge card instantly.
cards.lore: A better future is in the making. The moment we repair something, there will be more to work on.
cards.gradeReason: Woodpecker fixing gear is clear; long power text and repeated lore dilute the punch.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Woodpecker with tool belt drilling spinning gear cog, sparks flying. Iterative maker.

cards.power: Turn toxic soil into flora. Convert 2 Extractive damage tokens into 1 Regenerative resource.
cards.lore: The emergent political division: Extractive taking versus Regenerative repair.
cards.gradeReason: Beautiful image but lore is a framework label, not an invitation to perform.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Earthworm transforming toxic purple sludge into flowering garden, mushrooms blooming. Regeneration.

cards.power: Educate the board. Removes 1 Conspiracy token from all elderly cards in play.
cards.lore: Must be integrated into primary schools AND elderly re-education to survive the conspiracy wave.
cards.gradeReason: Squirrel hoarding rainbow books in tree is joyful; 'Conspiracy token' mechanic needs table frame.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Excited squirrel in glowing tree hollow surrounded by colorful floating books. Joyful knowledge.

cards.power: Root change. Discard the status quo board and replace it with something fundamentally different.
cards.lore: A survival strategy. Not just tweaks to the status quo, but something fundamentally different from the root.
cards.gradeReason: Psychedelic butterfly bursting from shredded spreadsheets. Transcendent. No explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Iridescent butterfly exploding from torn spreadsheets and data charts. Revolutionary becoming.

cards.power: Cross-pollinate. Connect two entirely different scientific disciplines to bypass a silo block.
cards.lore: The future is too complex for silos. We must cross-pollinate to survive.
cards.gradeReason: Neon spider web connecting disciplines is strong image; lore is a lecture, not an invitation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Spider weaving neon web connecting science beakers, cameras, chips and art palettes. Cross-pollination.

cards.power: Light up the dark. Players voluntarily pay you tokens to participate in your story.
cards.lore: People are hungry for stories worth participating in. Awe is what people actually want to pay for.
cards.gradeReason: Glowing firefly illuminating crowd of worshipping beetles in a cave. You ARE this character instantly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Luminous firefly on stage, crowd of beetles paying to bask in its glow. Awe economy.

cards.power: Gamify survival. Make climate action as addictive as doomscrolling. Draw 2 cards.
cards.lore: Make learning as addictive as a QAnon wormhole, but use it to tell stories that actually matter.
cards.gradeReason: Parrot holding book-world for animal audience is vivid; 'gamify survival' mechanic needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Colorful parrot spreading wings over living storybook world for rapt forest animals. Story ministry.

cards.power: Sniff out bad predictions. Force a Pop Futurist to discard their highest-funded failure.
cards.lore: Media must hold thought-leaders accountable when their heavily-funded futures fall or cause profound harm.
cards.gradeReason: Bloodhound sniffing failed prediction cards is clear; 'highest-funded failure' mechanic needs table context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Bloodhound nose-down on Mars Colony 2030 and Flying Cars prediction cards. Accountability journalism.

cards.power: Say no no no. Nefarious actors immediately fill the empty spaces on your board.
cards.lore: When you just say "no no no" without a hopeful vision, nefarious actors fill the power vacuum.
cards.gradeReason: Depressed blobfish in blackness is bleak and apt; card functions as warning AND character.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Despondent blobfish alone in absolute black void, nothing surrounding. Power vacuum.

cards.power: Wait to save everyone. Do nothing. Automatically triggers the Populism event card.
cards.lore: The dominant narrative that one magical person will save the day—leading directly to populism.
cards.gradeReason: Lion in cape posing while building burns. Clear but 'Populism event card' is mechanic-dense.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Muscular lion in cape posing heroically on pedestal, explosion behind. Populist savior myth.

cards.power: Disguise racism as math. Burrow into an elite futurism deck and rot it from the inside.
cards.lore: Look closely at the founders of elite futurism: full-on racist, ableist ideas disguised as math.
cards.gradeReason: Worm eating apple labeled 'Long Term' with sly glasses. Dark, immediate, historically sharp.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Grinning worm with spectacles burrowing through apple labeled 'Long Term'. Ideological rot.

cards.power: Spread 19th-century paranoia. Convince opponents that health upgrades will turn them into livestock.
cards.lore: Conspiracies aren't new. In the 19th century, they thought vaccines would turn you into a cow.
cards.gradeReason: Victorian cow-doctor in top hat. Historical absurdist conspiracy. Zero context needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Victorian gentleman-cow in top hat gesturing convincingly, penguin alarmed. Anti-vax history.

cards.power: Adjust the dial. Change opponent behavior today by lying about what's coming tomorrow.
cards.lore: If you tell people what is coming, they change their behavior today. Futurists hold this exact same power.
cards.gradeReason: Fat cat at interest rate machine is visually strong; the foresight-as-power concept needs unpacking.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Smug cat in pinstripes adjusting giant interest rate gauge amid lightning. Behavioral control.

cards.power: Hold the Overton open. Prevents the Hope card from being discarded this turn.
cards.lore: The huge responsibility of holding the Overton window open where hope actually lives.
cards.gradeReason: Chimp with dominoes is charming but 'Overton window' is a named concept requiring prior knowledge.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Thoughtful chimp carefully placing domino in long chain toward glowing horizon. Overton keeper.

cards.power: Deliver a colonial map. Force an opponent to copy your toxic growth model.
cards.lore: Erroneous language implying some nations are finished and dead, while others must copy their toxic growth.
cards.gradeReason: Stork in safari hat with colonial map in jungle is clear; postcolonial critique needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Stork in pith helmet presenting colonial map scroll in lush jungle. Development label.

cards.power: Swallow a microchip. Falsely claim a deep sociological crisis is solved. Lose 1 turn.
cards.lore: The dangerous lie that a single technology will solve deeply rooted sociological and anthropological crises.
cards.gradeReason: Penguin electrocuted by swallowed microchip is funny; lore explains rather than invites.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Panicked penguin swallowing glowing microchip, electricity arcing through body. Tech solutionism shock.

cards.power: Courage to act. Defeat any Doomerism card instantly. You cannot skip your turn.
cards.lore: True optimism requires courage to act, and anger against apathy. Doomerism is cowardice.
cards.gradeReason: Honey badger with anarchist sign and wrench charging forward. Unstoppable. Play it now.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Fierce honey badger charging with anarchist placard and wrench, flames behind. Radical hope.

cards.power: Top-up architecture. Combine 3 divergent cultural cards to build an indestructible hive.
cards.lore: Top-up, not top-down. We find better solutions precisely because of our divergent cultural perspectives.
cards.gradeReason: Bees building hive from diverse cards is beautiful; 'top-up architecture' is jargon.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Swarm of bees assembling massive golden hive from culturally diverse card fragments. Collective build.

cards.power: Regurgitate grants. Pay for a Global South player's flight instead of making them pay.
cards.lore: True equity means new grants to amplify Global South voices, not asking them to pay for their own flights.
cards.gradeReason: Pelican feeding smaller birds gold coins is warm; 'Global South player' mechanic needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Generous pelican regurgitating gold coins into nest of eager diverse chicks. Equity grants.

cards.power: Planetary scale vision. Move past the corporate realm and engage all citizens. Win the board.
cards.lore: Moving past the corporate realm to engage citizens on a truly planetary scale. Is this the future we want?
cards.gradeReason: Meerkat on sunrise cityscape is inspiring; lore ends with a question not an invitation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Upright meerkat surveying golden horizon cityscape with diverse small animals below. Citizen vision.

cards.power: Passive play is banned. Optimism must be backed by calloused hands.
cards.lore: Pessimism paralyzes. Optimism must bom backed backed by action wins. You cannot skip your turn.
cards.gradeReason: Cheetah at full sprint. Pure kinetic embodiment. You are this.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Cheetah at full sprint, blur lines, zero hesitation. Pure action.

cards.power: Trade cards with the margins. Winning alone is a Dystopian illusion.
cards.lore: No single player can win alone. You must trade cards with the margins.
cards.gradeReason: Griffin chimera of divergent species is compelling; 'trade with the margins' mechanic needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Chimeric griffin assembled from eagle, goat, fish, and serpent in harmony. Plurality embodied.

cards.power: Weave shredded corporate docs into a nest.
cards.lore: Every time you draw, you must repair one piece of the board. The game is never finished.
cards.gradeReason: Bird nesting in shredded quarterly earnings is tender; mechanic obligation dilutes the invitation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Small bird weaving nest from shredded 'CONFIDENTIAL' corporate documents. Tender repair.

cards.power: Flip the table. If the rules favor the extractive player, rewrite them.
cards.lore: If the rules favor the extractive player, flip the table and rewrite them. Stay fluffy!
cards.gradeReason: FrizzleBob burning rule books. Instant. The mascot destroying the ruleset is pure Kayfabizarro.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Manic yellow rabbit setting rule books ablaze with impish grin. Epistemic sabotage.

verdict: Propositum 2040 is the Kayfabizarro deck that actually has a thesis — and it sticks the landing. The villain roster (Disaster Capitalist, Philanthro-Capitalist, Dystopian Apathy) is some of the sharpest satirical design in the corpus: recognizable archetypes turned into game mechanics that make their ideology the weapon. The hero cards (Radical Hope Activist, Intersectional Octopus, Disability Justice Bear) match the energy. The four closing Rule cards as meta-cards is a structural masterstroke. Weak point: a handful of lore texts explain frameworks instead of embodying characters, and two cards end in questions. Table-ready: YES.
blurb: 56 cards, zero neutrality. Play the Disaster Capitalist, the QAnon Cultist, or the Radical Hope Activist in a satirical tabletop battle for 2040. For anyone who finds the future too important to leave to futurists.

coverQA.coverVisual: 5 — FrizzleBob on paintbrush-broomstick exploding through Corporate Futures Report is kinetic and iconic
coverQA.coverTitle: 4 — Propositum 2040: Forget Utopia / Ignore Dystopia / Embrace Protopia is quotable and punchy
coverQA.coverVibeMatch: 5 — Chaos rabbit vs. corporate documents perfectly encodes the deck's satirical energy
coverQA.coverOriginality: 4 — Paintbrush-as-broomstick and mascot-exploding-through-report is genuinely original
coverQA.coverViral: 4 — Title is tweetable, image is shareable, FrizzleBob mascot is recognizable brand anchor
coverQA.coverNote: One of the stronger covers in the corpus. The KayfaBIZARRO bug and the Blödsinn eye-flower in the corners do real supporting work — they make this a world, not just a card back. The GW watermark is clean without being intrusive.

notes: 15 pages total: 1 cover + 14 card pages × 4 cards = 56 cards. No RAF dice boxes present. Deck has clear ideological arc: opening 4 cards frame the Utopia/Dystopia/Extractive/Protopian quartet as structural thesis, then villain archetypes, then hero archetypes, then 4 meta-Rule cards as game mechanics-as-ideology. Rule of Action (card 53) has a typo in lore: 'Optimism must bom backed backed' should be 'Optimism must be backed'. Page 15 includes QR code and Substack URL (www.CancelThisComic.Substack.com/t/Kayfabizarro). The HUMBUG!, What the FLUFF?!, KayfaBINGO!, KayfaBOGGLE!, Stay fluffy!, and BLÖDSINN! stamps are baked-in page decorations, not cards. Gumroad-ready.

urgent: Fix typo in Rule of Action lore: 'must bom backed backed' → 'must be backed'
quickWins: Strengthen Regenerative Earthworm lore to be an invitation not a framework label
Give Citizen Engager a declarative lore close instead of a question
niceToHave: Consider splitting the deck into Villain / Hero subsets for easier onboarding
The 4 opening thesis cards (Utopian Mirage / Dystopian Apathy / Extractive Status-Quo / Protopian Process) could be a standalone intro mini-deck
